description: This file provides utility functions for file handling, including size validation, MIME type inference, file reading, existence checks, and remote file downloading, specifically tailored for use with the QQ Bot API.

methods.name: checkFileSize
methods.description: Validates if a file's size is within the maximum upload limit.

methods.name: readFileAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the contents of a file.

methods.name: fileExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a file exists and is readable.

methods.name: getFileSizeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a file asynchronously.

methods.name: isLargeFile
methods.description: Determines if a file size qualifies as large based on threshold.

methods.name: formatFileSize
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Infers MIME type from file extension.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a remote file into a local directory, generating a safe filename.
